lesson_text: C19+L22+D01 3F blend (50/30/20) with DD 8/22 + Regime overlay yields SR 0.793, CAGR 11.53%, MDD 30.0%. DD brake and regime overlay are PIT-clean (C9/C11 pass) but compress returns excessively — from parent SR ~0.93 to 0.79. L22 diversifier (corr=-0.108 vs C19) adds robustness (OOS 82%) but D01 at 20% weight dilutes alpha without sufficient defense benefit. 3-factor dilution pattern: adding defensive factors below critical weight threshold reduces SR without proportional MDD improvement.
